Problem Statement:
✨ Allow using dependables with `functools.partial()`

Discussion: https://github.com/tiangolo/fastapi/discussions/9744

I made `functools.partial` work for dependables in all combinations by unwrapping partials before FastAPI inspects the callable, in `fastapi/dependencies/models.py` and `fastapi/dependencies/utils.py`. Partials of async functions, callable classes and generators are now detected correctly. The existing `tests/test_dependency_class.py` tests pass (8 of 8), but I did not add tests for the new partial cases.
